analysis_plan.bootstrap: 10000 whole-world resamples, seed 981723; descriptive 95% percentile intervals
analysis_plan.sign_test: exact two-sided sign test on nonzero world-level contrasts; tests sign balance, not mean magnitude

analysis_plan.missing: retain invalid responses without resampling; complete-world estimates and full-plan bounds
analysis_plan.decision: fixed 480 planned calls; no scientific pass gate, extension, or automatic next study
analysis_plan.scope: fresh GPT-4o worlds with the target at row 10; no position-general or mechanistic claim
